title: Pizza For The House With No DOOR 🍕
description:
Every night at six I bring one large plain pizza to a house with no door. You slide the box through a brass slot at knee height, and a twenty slides back out, folded into a tiny house.

My big sister gave me her route this month. Tonight I got a flat tire two blocks away.

It's made up. A creepy blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Comment PLAIN if you'd still take this route.
